chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said:
"When a man permits his slave to manage his wealth, then he manages it as much as he wishes after he has permitted him to do so."
ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of a slave managing his master's wealth after receiving permission?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the legal status of *tadbir* (manumission upon death) or delegated financial authority, establishing that a master's explicit permission grants the slave full autonomy (*tasarruf*) over the specified wealth. In Shia jurisprudence, this underscores the principle that such permission creates a binding right, allowing the slave to manage or dispose of the assets without further restriction, reflecting the broader Islamic emphasis on contractual freedom and property rights.
